sections.title: Launch checks
sections.sql: select campaign,placement,starts_on,blocking_checks from launch_check order by starts_on

sections.title: Late follow-ups
sections.sql: select campaign,task,owner,due_on,days_late from overdue_tasks order by due_on

sections.title: Straight-line pacing
sections.note: Expected spend assumes an even daily profile. Check actuals freshness before making decisions. Each currency stays separate.
sections.sql: select campaign,placement,currency,planned_cents,spent_cents,expected_cents,variance_cents,freshness from pacing order by campaign,placement

sections.title: Invoice against recorded delivery
sections.note: A variance is an investigation prompt, not a payment instruction. No tax or currency conversion is applied.
sections.sql: select campaign,placement,currency,spent_cents,invoiced_cents,invoice_variance_cents from reconciliation order by campaign,placement
